note: Stages describe component delivery, not whole-product completion. Synthetic evidence is not real-model or physical evidence.

components.title: Primary Brain controller and replaceable local adapter
components.remaining: Bounded registered action plans work with actual local model. Open-ended plan synthesis and broad model-quality calibration remain.

components.title: Local-first reasoning and optional external experts
components.remaining: Local-first and explicit optional expert routing are integrated. Actual external-provider teacher acceptance remains; no paid fallback.

components.title: Unknown-task observation and safe experiments
components.remaining: Host materials/outcomes compile read/conversion plans without per-step instructions; source-derived artifact verification is integrated. Arbitrary novel decomposition/new executable tools and natural-language material authorization are not implemented.

components.title: Durable goal cognitive state and restart
components.remaining: Same-host restart, bound Goal/contract/root recovery and verified local effects pass. Unbound prior material histories require explicit review; arbitrary external effects and physical power-loss acceptance remain.

components.title: Memory and World Model execution-loop integration
components.remaining: Scoped memory/world updates are on the same execution loop. Broad domain prediction quality and cross-device transfer remain.

components.title: Unified verified learning and knowledge consolidation
components.remaining: Verified experiences feed existing memory/world/ClosedLearningLoop. Research campaign orchestration and generalization quality remain experimental.

components.title: Skill synthesis and regression demotion
components.remaining: Multiple verified goals synthesize host-catalog bindings; independent certification and quarantine tested. New executable procedures are not synthesized from prose.

components.title: Strategy scoring and failure intelligence
components.remaining: Failure avoidance and bounded scoring work. Full environment-specific cost/time/quality strategy calibration remains.

components.title: Explicit human correction learning
components.remaining: Explicit correction of existing verified attempts via service/CLI is integrated. Free-form human corrections and teaching UI binding remain.

components.title: Provenance-preserving historical learning import
components.remaining: Bounded supplied historical artifacts preserve provenance. Live GitHub harvesting and automatic history-to-verified-knowledge promotion are not implemented.

components.title: Expert suggestion verification and internal reuse
components.remaining: Synthetic expert-to-verified-host-skill reuse passes. Actual provider response/query/rejection learning coverage remains.

components.title: Local brain training-candidate pipeline
components.remaining: Private live verified experiences produce isolated training candidates. Fine-tuning/LoRA execution and model promotion are not activated.

components.title: Multi-user learning privacy partitions
components.remaining: Owner/tester partitions and sanitized generalized candidates are tested. Multi-user production identity provisioning and sharing authorization integration remain.

components.title: Offline and cross-device recovery
components.remaining: Same-host offline state/recovery is tested; network cross-device checkpoint transport and physical acceptance remain.

components.title: Independence benchmark with matched ablations
components.remaining: 12 metrics and matched bounded memory ablation are measured. Broad actual-model independence/transfer campaigns remain; absent denominators are null.

components.title: Governed self-improvement and verified rollback
components.remaining: R17 adapter rejects no-gain, requires independent/security checks and verifies rollback. Autonomous proposal-to-model/code promotion is not integrated.

components.title: Production intake and Goal execution integration
components.remaining: Actual Compass/Broker/API/Task UI candidate integrated. Hosts can configure either outcomes/materials or legacy steps; unconfigured goals inspect only. Normal intake-to-authorized-material setup and Production activation remain.
